remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -DWINVER=0x600)

remove_definitions(-D_CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE
    -D_CRYPT32_
)

spec2def(crypt32.dll crypt32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# crypt32.dll is all Rust (crypt32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# base64.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/base64.rs)
# cert.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/cert.rs)
# chain.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/chain.rs)
# collectionstore.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/collectionstore.rs)
# context.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/context.rs)
# crl.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/crl.rs)
# ctl.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/ctl.rs)
# decode.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/decode.rs)
# encode.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/encode.rs)
# filestore.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/filestore.rs)
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/main.rs)
# message.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/message.rs)
# msg.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/msg.rs)
# object.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/object.rs)
# oid.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/oid.rs)
# pfx.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/pfx.rs)
# proplist.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/proplist.rs)
# protectdata.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/protectdata.rs)
# provstore.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/provstore.rs)
# regstore.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/regstore.rs)
# rootstore.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/rootstore.rs)
# serialize.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/serialize.rs)
# sip.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/sip.rs)
# store.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/store.rs)
# str.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/str.rs)
# reactos/store.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/reactos_store.rs)
# reactos/unixlib.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-rust/src/crypt32/unixlib.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(crypt32_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(crypt32_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libbcrypt libuser32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32_vista libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(crypt32_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro
add_cargo_module(crypt32 crypt32-cargo crypt32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE crypt32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS crypt32_shims psdk)
